samf-senior-2020-r1-01.prompt: A number is multiplied by 20 to give a value of 2020. What is the number?

samf-senior-2020-r1-02.prompt: How many letters of the word $\textsf{MICHAEL}$ have no lines of symmetry?

samf-senior-2020-r1-03.prompt: What is the probability of getting a 5 or a 6 when a fair die is rolled once?

samf-senior-2020-r1-05.prompt: What is the value of the expression $(2001 - 2002)(2003 - 2004)(2005 - 2006)\cdots(2019 - 2020)$?

samf-senior-2020-r1-06.prompt: An amount of money is shared in the ratio of $2 : 3 : 4$ and the one who received the most gets R76. What is the amount originally shared, in Rands?

samf-senior-2020-r1-07.prompt: Last Saturday, Randburg Fruiterers sold 120 kg of fruit. In a pie chart of the sales per kilogram, the sector for bananas has a central angle of $45^\circ$. How many kilograms of fruit sold were not bananas?

samf-senior-2020-r1-08.prompt: How many 3-digit numbers $abc$ are there such that the sum of the first and last digits is 11?

samf-senior-2020-r1-09.prompt: Phil has a rectangular patio in his garden. He decides to make the patio larger by increasing both its length and width by 10%. What is the percentage increase in the area of the patio?

samf-senior-2020-r1-10.prompt: In triangle $TAS$, $YR = YS$, $\hat A = 2\,Y\hat RS$ and $\hat T = 3\,Y\hat RS$. What is the size of $\hat S$ in degrees?

samf-senior-2020-r1-11.prompt: What is the size of each interior angle of a regular 720-sided polygon?

samf-senior-2020-r1-12.prompt: How many zeros are there at the end of the number $9^{999} + 1$?

samf-senior-2020-r1-13.prompt: What is the remainder when the number $743\,589\times 301\,647$ is divided by 5?

samf-senior-2020-r1-14.prompt: The captains and coaches of the four soccer teams Orlando Pirates, Mamelodi Sundowns, Kaizer Chiefs and Supersport United are having an arm wrestling competition. Each team has one captain and one coach. Everyone must wrestle everyone else, except that no captain will wrestle his own coach. How many arm wrestling bouts (matches) are there?

samf-senior-2020-r1-15.prompt: In the diagram $\angle PQR = 8^\circ$, and a sequence of isosceles triangles is drawn as shown. What is the largest number of such triangles that can be drawn?

samf-senior-2020-r1-16.prompt: Jack and Peter live 13 km from one another. One afternoon at 16:00 Jack started at his house and rode on his bicycle towards Peter's house. Peter started a few minutes later at his house and rode towards Jack's house. They met after Peter rode for $x$ hours and Jack for $3x$ hours. Jack's speed is $\frac34$ Peter's speed. How many kilometres is Peter from his house when they meet?

samf-senior-2020-r1-17.prompt: All angles in the figure are $90^\circ$. The lengths of $g$, $h$ and $d$ are 7, 6 and 3, respectively. What is the perimeter of the figure?

samf-senior-2020-r1-18.prompt:
You may start at any square on the diagram and move up, down, left or right (NOT diagonally) to an adjacent square. No square may be used more than once. Write down the digits of each square as you proceed. What is the MIDDLE DIGIT of the largest 9-digit number that can be made?

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline 5 & 9 & 1\\\hline 8 & 4 & 7\\\hline 3 & 6 & 2\\\hline\end{array}$$

samf-senior-2020-r1-19.prompt:
For each odd integer we can write $S_1 = 1$, $S_2 = 1 + 3 = 4$, $S_3 = 1 + 3 + 5 = 9$ etc. For every second odd integer we can write $C_1 = 1$, $C_2 = 1 + 5 = 6$, $C_3 = 1 + 5 + 9 = 15$, etc. Which fraction does not belong to the sequence below?
$$\frac{S_1}{C_1},\ \frac{S_2}{C_2},\ \frac{S_3}{C_3},\ \dots$$

samf-senior-2020-r1-20.prompt: $AB$ is a diameter of a circle with radius 1 cm. Two circular arcs of equal radius are drawn with centres $A$ and $B$. These arcs meet on the circle, as shown. What is the shaded area, in cm$^2$?
